guardian.requirements.text: Use authentic Sleepyhead logo artwork and appropriate supplied variant; preserve its proportions, colours, contrast and clear space. Do not rotate, distort, recolour, bevel, emboss or add a drop shadow. No production logo artwork is present in the supplied materials.

The excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042. The white specification conflicts: RGB indicates #FFFFFF, while the printed hex is #231F20. Treat white as unresolved; do not use #231F20 as white.
The excerpts name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. Font availability and licensing are unconfirmed; do not claim exact rendering unless verified.
Keep selected colours, patterns and mixed design elements cohesive; the excerpts call for bold colour, playful patterns and asymmetry.

guardian.preferences.text: Supplied excerpts describe a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and playful Jester identity focused on connection and enjoyment. This is supplied positioning, not proof of audience response.
Favor humorous, informal, creative and personable language; keep it useful and clear, and avoid unsupported product promises.

As advisory inspiration, consider the whole domestic space—architecture, circulation, colour relationships, daylight, furniture grouping and lived-in activity. Expressive, patterned rooms and quieter alternatives are both represented; no single room formula is required.
The official site currently presents a broad home-comfort range and uses the lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark with orange accents. This is an observation, not a mandatory campaign template.

facts.text: Sleepyhead’s official FAQ describes it as an Indian brand.

brandGuidance.findings.title: Sleep and home-comfort range
brandGuidance.findings.text: Sleepyhead’s official site presents a broad home-comfort range including mattresses, beds, sofas, sofa beds, recliners, pillows and other home furnishings. The site describes the brand as Indian.

brandGuidance.findings.title: Supplied identity guidance
brandGuidance.findings.text: The supplied Sleepyhead guideline excerpts describe a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and fabulous identity, with a Jester archetype focused on connection and enjoyment. The excerpts are partial; their original version and approval status are not established.

brandGuidance.findings.title: Colour, typography and mark
brandGuidance.findings.text: Guideline excerpts specify orange #F15A22 and charcoal #414042, and name Migrena Grotesque for brand typography and Source Sans Pro for web typography. The supplied white specification conflicts: RGB 255,255,255 implies #FFFFFF, while the printed hex is #231F20; treat #FFFFFF as an interpretation pending correction. The guide describes a lowercase wordmark and closed-eye “ee” motif; no production logo artwork or Migrena Grotesque font files are supplied.

brandGuidance.findings.title: Conversational, playful voice
brandGuidance.findings.text: Supplied voice guidance favours humorous, informal, creative and personable language, including wit and wordplay, while remaining useful and clear and avoiding unsupported product promises.

brandGuidance.findings.title: Whole-room inspiration, not a fixed template
brandGuidance.findings.text: The client-selected spatial board is advisory inspiration, not a mandatory brand rule or Sleepyhead product evidence. Its supplied research describes expressive domestic spaces using colour, pattern, rounded forms, daylight and lived-in activity, alongside quieter alternatives. The bounded image subset includes a peach sectional in a bright room and an open-plan room with architectural colour zoning; these are references, not exact Sleepyhead products.
